evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rises monotonically through growth: 4.1 → 6.0 → 13.1 → 19.6 → 26.5 ppm at constant Ar 100 sccm, versus ~3-7 ppm baseline during ramp
Ar flow steady at ~99-100 sccm, so the rise is not from a flow change
Temperature holds 750 °C with stable heater power ~46%; thermal control looks normal
pressure_gauge not installed, so tube atmosphere/leak-tightness cannot be independently verified

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure (gauge not installed) to distinguish an air in-leak from O2-sensor drift; an Ar step-change or flow-off test to see whether O2 scales inversely with dilution, plus post-run leak check.
